title.rendered: Kiierr Daily Saw Palmetto for Hair Growth

content.rendered:
Kiierr Saw Palmetto Vitamins

DHT inhibition: Reduces levels of dihydrotestosterone (DHT), a hormone associated with hair loss.

Anti-inflammatory properties: Has anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate scalp inflammation and create a favorable environment for hair growth.

Improved blood circulation: Enhances blood flow to the scalp, ensuring that hair follicles receive essential nutrients and oxygen for healthy hair growth.

 

Learn About Saw Palmetto:

Saw Palmetto: Shown to lower the levels of DHT in both men and women and it does that by blocking the main enzyme called 5-alpha reductase which can build up around the base of the hair follicle. It also helps loosen build up on the scalp that reduces and restricts micro-circulation and capillary blood flow and delivery of vital nutrients and minerals to the follicle papilla and cuticle.

 

Also check out our DHT blocking shampoo, Conditioner for Hair Growth, and Biotin Gummies to add to your hair growth supplement routine.
